messages:
nina: FYI support is getting a cluster of tickets — customers seeing 502/504s for hosted API after the seed release at 00:12 UTC. A few also reported auth errors and client timeouts.
sam: Thanks — oncall looking. Which endpoints?
nina: /v1/generate and /v1/chat mostly, spikes in gateway errors and a lot of 30s client timeouts. One customer pasted this curl: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> HTTP/2 502
deploy-bot: Deploy 3799000921 by kevin -> staged rollout to 10% started 00:11:58 UTC.
jordan: I see the routing flag `seed-routing-v2` was flipped into staged mode in that deploy. Telemetry shows increased backend 502s from the new route instances at ~00:13.
tess: I pulled the gateway logs — getting `upstream read timeout` and `connection reset by peer` from a subset of GPU hosts. Also some token validation logs show `JWT missing kid` for a small percentage.
kevin: I pushed a canary with a config change that routes a subset to the new kernel selector and a binary flag `enable_prefetch=true`.
sam: Hypothesis: the kernel selector + prefetch flag combination exposes auth header truncation or long-tail latency -> upstream timeouts. Can someone repro locally with the exact config?
jordan: Repro steps I used: `k run debug-client --image=alpine/curl -- sh -c "for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H 'Authorization: Bearer valid-token' https://staging-gw.redwood/v1/generate; done"` -> on routed hosts I get ~15% 502 and occasional `401` in token-checker svc.
nina: Affected customers include ACME and Boltlytics — ACME reports billing events failing on retry which is compounding errors.
tess: I'm paging infra to inspect kernel memory pressure. Also adding a temporary increased read timeout on the gateway to 45s to reduce client-visible 504s.
kevin: Rolling the flag back now: `kubectl set env deployment/seed-router ENABLE_PREFETCH=false -n prod` — starting rollback at 00:25 UTC.
deploy-bot: Rollout: flag change applied to 100% of seed-router pods at 00:26:10 UTC.
sam: After flag rollback, telemetry: 502 rate on /v1/generate dropped from 6.2% to 0.8% in the last 5m. Latency p95 also improved.
jordan: Verified with curl loop against same routed hosts — 502s gone, JWT auth failures gone. Looks like prefetch path was exposing a header race.
kevin: I'll open a follow-up PR to gate prefetch behind auth-compat checks and add a test.
tess: Next steps: run additional soak for 1h, run the canary with 1% and explicit auth-header tests before any wider rollout. I'll update the runbook note: add step to validate `Authorization` header length and kid presence in canary tests.
nina: I updated customers: ACME support ticket patched with root cause + mitigation; billing retries cleared.
sam: Closing incident: revert confirmed, metrics stable for 20m, customers notified. Assigning postmortem to kevin/jordan/tess. :white_check_mark:
